    What is Chloé Zhao's most famous movie?
    An AI Overview is not available for this searchCan't generate an AI overview right now. Try again later.
    AI Overview
    Chloé Zhao's most famous film is undoubtedly Nomadland (2020), which brought her international acclaim and major awards, including the Academy Award for Best Director, making her the second woman to win the prestigious award, while the film itself won Best Picture, cementing its status as a landmark achievement in modern cinema.
     
    This official trailer gives you a glimpse of the film's atmosphere:
    48s
    Focus Features
    YouTube · Oct 9, 2025
    Here's why Nomadland stands out:
    • Critical & Commercial Success:
      It resonated deeply with audiences and critics, winning numerous accolades. 
    • Major Awards:
      Besides the Oscars, it won Golden Globes and BAFTA awards for Best Picture and Best Director. 
    • Career Defining:
      The film's success marked a defining moment in Zhao's career, elevating her from independent filmmaking to mainstream recognition. 
    While her other films like The Rider (2017) and the Marvel blockbuster Eternals (2021) are also notable, Nomadland is her most celebrated and recognized work.

      What is Zhao Ting's nationality?
      Chinese
      Chloé Zhao (born Zhao Ting, in Chinese: 赵婷; 31 March 1982) is a Chinese filmmaker. She is known primarily for her work on independent films. For her film Nomadland (2020), Zhao became the second woman to win the Academy Award for Best Director.
